limitations_before_freeze: Seed rows are provisional until API identity, source timestamp, and replay deck handshakes all verify.
Opponent archetypes in the frozen manifests must be derived from the full replay deck, not team-level survey labels.
No replay in FINAL_HOLDOUT may be inspected beyond deck/order/outcome metadata before the policy is frozen.

selection_provenance.source: Bounded local Kaggle metadata/cache audit plus current EpisodeService metadata on 2026-08-12/13
